reference: Mi waddi bingel am mo dubi jenayi Nyaurdorde hanne ƴaloma. Mi lili bingel on siri sooda Naƴam goɗun amma bosaaru ngati mo. De ɓe waddi cukaley on wuro ɓe hecci am ko fayti , Mi raɓɓuti futtere to bosaaru ɗun ngati cukaley on,Mi tawi futtere non wujji bo ɓuuti.  Men waɗi ƴamde  dere keddiraɓe mo andi bosaaru nga ƴati bingel on. Joom bosaaru ɗun wi'i ɓe meeɗa hokkuko bosaaru on Njibinanɗe .Ɓe wi'i ɗun yaha yasi dun  fija ɗu warta tan. Ɓe wi'i ɓe meeɗa hokkuko bosaaru ɗun lekki sam. Kanjum waɗi  mi huli se mi yaawi wadduko bingel on Nyaurdorde, gan to bosaaru ɗun ngati cukaley on no wodi ƴau bosaaru . Ɗume  heɓɓata bingel ko bosaaru ngati bo?  Ɗume wawi heɓɓa  futtere wojju ɗun e ɓuutu ɗun? Nƴau bana ƴau bosaaru waawi nasta dere futere? Ko waawi waɗɗuko bingel on sabun ngati bosaaru on? Ko ɗume goɗɗum min waawi waɗɗuko wala ko lekki min waawi waɗɗanko futtere ɗen to bosaaru ɗun ngati ɓingel on?
model_answer: Ngam ɓosaru ndu alaa fitoore (vaccine) ngati ɓiɗɗo maa, o ɗon mari hatere heɓugo nyau haandi (rabies) bee nyau mborosaaji ngam buutuure nde a yi'i on. Yaawu lootugo futere nden bee ndiyam keewɗam bee sabunde (soap) faa minti sappo e jowi (15 mins) joni-joni ngam riiwugo nyau man. Waddan ɓiɗɗo on asibiti joni ngam o heɓa fitoore nyau ɓosaru (Rabies PEP) bee lekki kofotooɗo mborosaaji (antibiotics) e tetanus. Taa waddu leɗɗe gure ko kofeti dow futere nden, ngam ɗum ɗon ɓeyda buutuure nden mbonka. Hakkiilo bee ɓosaru ndun faa balɗe sappo (10 days) ngam yi'ugo ko kuuje feere waɗata ngun, amma taa njeeɗon ngam fuɗɗugo fitoore ɓiɗɗo on.

question: dai bo je jodata hasari amin o huwa dowada kugal mako bo o wala nyawu yande fere wakkati o do yi wa o nane en e mako do mari hunde petel satinga hada o numi wala ko dume o nani wala ko dume o lari o nani dum fahim nyande fere fahim do wakkati o dillai o fuddi numugo be mai sosai o fuddi numugo de mai on ha en e nyaku wala nyamugo molana wamo amma babali mai o sati bo sali dillugo o fuddi tum bo labari je ingol robbe je mari dum ha'i ndi naddi sati je sali o yahi larugo likita o yidi o anda dume on dasi dum de dumi on o wadata hala mai mdejema mdejemako mi on dasata hunde mai ha'i en idi bo ko mi onje satinga ha'i en i'o nagansa mi on de bolora talara fahim ha'i en imai
reference:
Debbo je jodata ha sare amen, do huwa.
Do wada kuugal maako  boddum bo o wala yeiwu. Yende fera, waakati odo yiwa, o nane endi maako dou mari hunde petel satinga hader. O numi wala ko duma , o lori o nane dun fahen yende fera fahen do . Waakati do dellal, o fudi damugo be mai sosai, o fudi numugo dimai on ha endi maako. Wala nawa mo, amma balal mai do sati bo sali dellu go. O fudi num tugo labari je binkon robe je mari don ha endi mabe. Sati je sali,  o yeti larugo likita.  O kidi o anda dumi on dasi dum be dume on o wadata hala mai. Made jima: dumi on dasata hunde mai ha endi debbo? Koh dume o je satin ga  ha endi on na cancer? Dume on debbo lora ta lara fahim ha endi mai?
model_answer:
Hunde satinga (ɓuure) ha endu gorko e waawi wurtoago saabe canjiiji ngolɗol ɓandu (hormones), jonte (infection), koo boo kanisur endu (breast cancer) ko feere-feere. Ko laari ɗum ɗon ɓuri heɓugo rewɓe, ammaa gorko boo e waawi heɓugo ɗum, nden boo naa kala ɓuure satinga woni kanisur. 

O waɗi booɗɗum sanne nde o yahi asibiti; likita ɗon waɗan mo fiptungo bee masin (ultrasound) koo o ɓosa petel (biopsy) ngam anndugo ko woni woodi. Safarki man e waawi laataago lekkiiji koo boo tafaango (surgery) ngam ittugo ɓuure man to ɗum haajiri. Ndelle, yo o usti kulol e gite mako, o tokko dille likita makko ngam o heɓa jaajol e cellal mako.

question: jabore dum mo dum e safa neto teteti mo diri di lebbiji di'i ke dure makowai nga dimo nyawu do be am mi dai wi'i reduma fana mo dum dum e wi'i enko e wuti leya samako e o inna e o woya ngawna en bon kodi sembe mako sawa en makko biben sara en makko bi e don kodi tawi mutawa dada ko mungel dun yamde arandere de nyauto yami nyamde diga beren dume hani wadi gobela wo hade borede wojo on nyamre teta wure dume hanira bute go hefta nyamdun damreno yauren ero nde kikiya hani nyamderemo damrejo yauren ero nyamden di'a owadato bebo ero gendam dayayya hani of ujira

Debbo reedujo mo dubi sappane tati e tati mo wodi reedu lebbi jeeɗiɗi keddu en makko ngaddimo Nyaurdorde amin. Ɓe wi'i  reedu mako no nawɗum tenduɗum, ƴiiyan ko ɗuɗi wurti le yeso mako. Ii 'o diwna ,I'o woya ngam nawɗun dun ɓurimo semɓe.  Saro en makko mbii be don kultori ta godɗun tawa Dada ko bingel ngel.

Ƴamnde arandere nde Nyautowo ƴami :  dume on wadi reedu naawurta non ha ma ƴiiƴam wurto e sembe?
Ƴamnde ɗi dabre: Dume haani waɗugo ɓelau ha debbo reedujo on?
Ƴamre tataure: Dume haani raɓɓu tugo hefta nyau dum?
Ƴamre Nayabre: Irin lekki kiye haani nyaudiramo?
Ƴamre Joyabre: ira Nyamdu nduye o woɗoto, nden bo ira ngendam dayeejam haani o hutira?
model_answer:
To ɓiɗɗo ma ɗon dogginee reedu, o ɗon woya kadi sembe maako ɗon lora, ɗum ɗon holla o ɗon joola (dehydration), nden kam yaadu asibiti ɗon jaɓɓi. 

Hokku mo ndiyam guri (ORS) bana no safarooɓe mbi'i, nden kadi ta tewtu kosam enndu dada gam ɗum ɗon sembiɗina ɓandu maako. 

To ɓiɗɗo man heɓi lebbi joweego e dow, waɗu mo mbusiri welndi bee teeburuji e kosam haa o heɓa sembe. 

Tokku hokkugo mo nyamdu sedda-sedda kofeeji ɗuɗɗe gam o lora o heɓa sembe, kadi ta accu mo o ɗon ɗonna reedu ɓooyma. 

Yahdu asibiti ɓadiiɗo law gam safarooɓe yeewa mo, ɓe ngena ko saabi nyawu man kadi ɓe hokka mo magungunaaji potɗi.

question: jam ɓanɗu likita useni mi waɗi ɓingel am siɓɓiti ngam mi laari no fofata ɗon woni bana sautu henɗu ɗo sala babel petel ni ɗon bo bana goɗɗo ɗon fufa hunde bo daker o fofata mi hirliti bo balde tati jotta o ɗo ɗodda be jemma wakkati fere miɗo lara ɓerde mako ɗo nasta sossai lukka ɗo sossai bana sauto naftiri sembe mako o fofata milari bo o wala nyama bana ni to o nyamai fu sauto to nyamai fu sauto o nangi fofɗe mako seto o nangi fofɗe mako irin banni mai ɗon hokkata mo bone o ɗo kasa nyamugo boɗɗum balɗe tati jotta mi arti mi yari mo kemist petel ha fattude amin ɓe hokki mo lekki ɗojjugo ngam o ɗo ɗojja seɗɗa seɗɗa amma ɗojjugo mai hallai amma pat lekkiji o yari wala ko nafi mo fofugo mako bannin ni kuma har jotta o wawata nyamugo boɗɗum useni irin damuwa toi damata ɓingel am be fofugo mako ɗo bana hendu ɗo saala babel petum useni o handini hotona heɓa famta ko damatamo be kwaɗi ɓernde mako ɗo fatta jippa ɗo irin nyamdiji toi mi hokkata ɓingel ɗo ha saare hoyninamo heba o foofa boɗɗum ɗon irin lekkiji feere sibitinaa ko hundeji tan feere mataaki je hosata haɗo ɓingel ɗo
reference:
Jam bandu likita, useni mi waddi bingel am sibiti gam mi laari no o foofata, don woni bana sawtu hendu do saala babal petel ni, donbo bana goddo don fuufa hunde, be daker o foofata. Mi hirliti bo balde tati jotta odo dojja be jamma. Wakati fere mido lara berde mako do nasta sosai lugga, do fa’a do sosai bana saito naftiri sembe mako o foofata. Milaribo owala yaama banaane.
To o yammai fu saito onangi fofde mako. Irin bani mai don hokkatamo bone odo kasa yamugo boddum balle tati jotta. Mi arti mi yari mo chemist petel ha fattude amin, be hokkimo lekki dojjugo gam odo dojja sedda sedda, amma dojjugo mai hallai .
Amma pat lekkiji o yari wala ko nafimo.
Foofugo mako bannin ni, kuma harjotta o wawata yamugo boddum. Useni irin damuwa toidamata mingel am be foofugo mako do bana hendu do saala babel piitum?
Useni o haadini hooto na? Heba famta ko daamata mo be kwadi berde mako do fada jippa do?
Irin yaudigi toi mihokkata mingel do ha sare, hoininamo heba o foofa boddum?
Don irin lekkiji fere sibiti na ko hundeji tan fere mataaki je hosata hado bingel do?
model_answer:
No fofata be no ɓernde makko nastata ɗon, e jotta bo o waata nyamugo, ɗum maale caɗeele foofugo mawɗe (severe respiratory distress) bana nyawu ponduki (severe pneumonia). 

Ta ɓeɗɗu wonugo ha saare malla nafturgo lekkiiji kemist, useni yahdu asibiti mawɗo jotta-jotta ngam o heɓa oksijin be lekkiiji poofidinki ha juuɗe likita'en. 

Lekki kofol ngol ngadduda ha kemist wallata mo ngam datɗi poofɗe makko ɗon ɓilli kadi ɗon mari peesci (mucus). 

Gam haala nyamdu, to o ɗo wawi yardugo, hokko mo ndiyam belɗam seɗɗa-seɗɗa malla kosam enndu, amma ta tilsu mo nyamdu mawndu nde o fofata bee caɗeele ngam ta o lora (choking). 

Yahdu asibiti jotta on woni ko hisnata yonki ɓingel ma, don ɗon ɓe kaɓata hootona (X-ray) ɓernde makko ngam ɓe annda ko damata mo sossai.

question: goɗɗo ɓe noddata subeeru duuɓi makko cappanɗe joyi nyannde ngon feere o fuɗɗi ƴowru arannde bo ƴowru ɗum yaaɗaayi ammaa nde ɗum faɓɓi asaweejo seɗɗa tan yaarugo lebbi ɓe hakkilo ɗum yahi ɗum halloyi nde neeɓi seɗɗa sey ɗum saldoriimo poppe ɗum goonga on o haɓdi bawɗe ko o waawata hinde ko nyawuru ɗum sataayi ammaa ɗum pat manjum ɗum waɗaayi nde hannuno o nyamɗita ƴowru tolliti nde o hillitii dow o yaha o sooda lekki dikka o yaha nyawdorde o yi'a nyawtoowo nde o yokki nyawdorde o hecci ɓe o ɗo ɗujja lebbi tati ko saali o lori fayin o hecci ɓe o haɓdii ko o waawata waɗugo bana ko yimɓe shaawari mo ko laarani jumri ndiyam fowuɗam goro jum kaɗɗu heɓele ki ɗuuɗi ke ko o suudi dahaanuno o nyamɗita sell njomuru wari tulliti ɗunyotte ke wakkati feere fofo gomahe saldaromo ganjowuro ɗum nyaaɗi se o ƴami nyawtawo on ko waɗi nyowuru ɗum neeɓiri bane ni salu nyamɗitugo o yiɗi o anda ko waɗi dabareji ɓe leɗɗe ɗe o fuuɗi fuu nafayi ragaro men o ƴami ɗume o wannata ƴowuru ɗum ɗum nyamɗita fuumaru ngam o heɓa o foofa no hani o lornita jam ɓandu makko
reference:
Goɗɗo ɓeno data Suberu, duɓi mako sappaɗe joyi, ƴande fere ofuuɗi ƴowru. Arande bo ,ƴowru ɗun ƴaaɗai amma  de ɗun faɓɓi asaweje seeɗa tan yarigo lebbi, be hakkiilo ni ɗun yehi ɗun Halloi. De neɓi seeɗa , se saldorimo bobɗe . Ɗun goĝa on o habdi bauɗe ko o wawata hinddeeko nyouru dun satayi amma ɗun pat manju ɗun waɗai. Da hanuno o ƴamɗita ,ƴowru tulliti. De O hilliti ,dou o yaha o soda lekki dikka o yaha  Nyaurdorde o yi'a Nyautowo. Nde o yokki  Nyaurdorde ,o yecci ɓe ,o ɗou ɗojja lebi tati ko saali.  O lori  fa hin ,o hecci ɓe o habdi ko wawata waɗuko bana ko hiɓɓe shawarimo ko larini jumri, diyan fowuɗan ,goroju-kaɗɗu,e ɓe lekki ɗuɗuki ko o soodi . Da hanuno ,O nyamɗinta se ŋyowru wari tulliti. Ɗun yottaki wakkati feere, fofugo ma e saldoramo ngam ŋyouru ɗum ƴaɗi . Se O ƴami Nyautowo on ,ko waɗi ƴowru ndum neɓir bana ni,sali yamɗutuko. O yinno o anda ko waɗi dabareji be leɗɗe ɗe o foodi fu ko nafayi .
Ragare mai ,on nƴami ɗume o wannata ƴowru dum ɗu nyamɗita dufuumaru ,ngam o heɓa o foofa no hani  o lorinita jamo bandu mako.
model_answer: Nyaw ƴowru neeɓndu bana ndu lebbi tati, na foti wonugo maale nyawuji caɗtuɗi bana pahu (Tuberculosis) malla caɗeele pofol, nden kadi duuɓi maa cappanɗe joyi ɗon ɓeyda riskiku man. Lekkiiji ladde, goro, e jumri mballataako ngam kurugol nyawuji mawɗi bana ɗi, ɗum kadi ɗon halkude ma wakkati ngam heɓugo nyawndugol gonga. Ko haani mbadɗaa joni woni a yaha suudu nyawndirdu mawndu (hospital) ngam ɓe njannga tuutre maa (sputum test) nden ɓe mbeɗa nate gaba maa (Chest X-ray). To tawaama ɗum nyaw pahu (TB) on, nyawndugol man ɗon mari caahu (free) e nder asibitiiji laamu nden bo a sellan kadi a foofa jam. Ngam man, accee hoosugo lekkiiji walaa qira'a walla leɗɗe ladde, yheehee asibiti joni-joni ngam asibiti on tan woni laawol sellal maa.

question: dada debboje danye nebai wari sibiti o bi tun bingel mako danye o dauta rufe iyam sosai kanjum wadi o wala sembe ha bandu mako den bo mo danyi mai dubi mago nogas e nayi o bi bo rufugo iyam mai dudi masin danta bo wata mo o wala sembe dada mai kasi yamugo be kuma kasi wadugo ko ɗume dembe am kanjum dume on waddata debbo dinga rufugo iyam ɗo bawo danyi balɗe seɗɗa sali ɗum nyaudiiku toy ɓe hokkata dada mai jey rufugo iyam may darata den bo o lorna sembe mako shawara toy hokkata dada may ɓe ɓingel mako am
reference:
Dada debbo je dayi nebai wari sibiti . Ovi tun bingel mako dayi odota rufa eyam sosai.
Kanjum wadi owala sembe ha bandu mako.
Debbo mo dayi mai dubi mako nogas e ni. Ovi bo rufugo eyam mai duudi masin denta bo watamo owala sembe.
Daada mai kasi yamugo be kuma kasi wadugo kodume.
Demde am kanjum dumedon waddata debbo ninga rufugo eyam do bawo o dayi balde sedda sali do? 
Yaudiku toi be hokkata daada mai je rufugo eyam mai darata denbo olorna sembe mako? Shawara toi hokkata daada mai be bingel mako?
model_answer:
Rufugo iyam ɗuɗɗum ɓaawo danygol (secondary PPH) ɗon waddoo ngam saabi heddiije riga danygol luttuɗe nder daada, walla guurte (infection), e riga danygol ngol ustaaki no haandiri. 

Ngam nyawndugo ɗum, haandi ɓe hokka mo lekkiije mballooje riga danygol ustagol (uterotonics) bana Oxytocin walla Misoprostol, ɓe njuwa mo iyam bee ndiyam fitiila (IV fluids), e lekkiije kunooje nyawu (antibiotics). 

O yiɗi kadi lekkiiji ɓallinooji iyam (iron supplements) bee nyaamduuji mardɗi sembe bana teewu, ɓiraadam, bee liɗɗi ngam o heɓta sembe maako law. 

Mi ɗon saawaaro dada man o daddina ɓiɗɗo man enndu tan (exclusive breastfeeding) ngam ɗum ɗon walla riga danygol ustagol, den bo o fowta sosai o acca dunyaaru ko say o selliti. 

To on ngi'i alamaji ba jonte, luuɓol iyam man, walla ɓeydagol ɗonki sembe, ngaddon mo sibiti lawlaw ngam hisngo yonki maako bee ɓiɗɗo mako.

question: dattijo gorko warini amin sibiti goɗɗo wi'i o ɗo nana hoore mako ɗo nawa daande mako ɗo tiiɗi be kuma foofe peppetel wurtini mo ha ɓandu o wari emugo ɗume on waddata irin ɗo be kuma irin dawa toi hokkatamo min emi goɗɗo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warini mo na ko seɗɗa seɗɗa warinimo dottijo mai wi warinimo jemma den bo halli jotta min eminimo bo o ɗo lara hite na o wi a'a ngam hite o tullinamo nawol hore min emi mo fu hala fofe ha ɓandu mako koɗo nawa sosai ko seɗɗa seɗɗa dottijo mai wi fu finimo pat ɓandu kuma o wawata ewugo da pellel bi'ugo da pellel gotel amma ɗo yayamo ɓawo kanjum min emimo ko o fotti be nyauɗo ovi wala oyahi banda sorugo hunde ha yeso sare maɓɓe ɗemɗe amin hari kita kanjum ɗon ko waddata nawol hore be dande tiddataɗo har o wala wailita dande be fofe kohatoi ha ɓandu mako ɗume waddata ɗum nyawu je raɓata ɗon naa ko hundeji fere ɗemɗe am jeɗiɗa bo irin godi toi goɗɗo ɗo waɗata en andata lallai ko heɓi mo heɓa anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirta ba ko jaaɓo rugo furta
reference:
Dottijo gorko warini Amin sibiti, goddo vii, odo nana hore mako donaawa. Daade mako do tiidii, be kuma foofe per peton vurtino ha bandu . Owari emugo dume don waddata irin do be kuma irin dawa toi hokkatamo. Min emmi goddo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warinimo na ko sedda sedda warinimo. Dottijo mai vi warinimo jamma denbo halli jotta. Min emmi mo bo odo laara hiite na? Ovi aa gam hiite o tullinamo naawol hore. Min emmi mo fu hala foofe ha bandu mako ko do naawa sosai ko sedda sedda. Dottijo mai vi foofinimo pat bandu bo kuma o wawata viyuwa da pelel gotel amma do nyanya mo.
Bawo kanjum min emmi mo ko o fotti be nyado . Ovi wala ha oyahi, banda sorrugo hunde ha yeso sare mabbe.
Dembe amin ha likita kanjum don kowaddata nyawol hore be daade tiidata do har o wala waylita daade, be foofe ko hatoi ha bandu mako? Dumewaddatadum? Ye’u je raabata donnaa or hundeji fere? Dembe am je didabo irin goji toi goddo do wadata en andata lallai kohebimo, heba anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirita bako jabargo vurta?
model_answer: Nyawu ngujiri dottiijo man heɓi yo **Meningitis** (nyawu ɓatton-hoore/ɗatal ɓendam-hoore), nden ɗum laati jankirde mawnde nde haani yaɓɓeego dow mu'um lawlaw ngam hisngo yonki makko. Nawol hoore, daande tiiɗunde, mettugo hite, be foofe petel-petel haa ɓandu makko fuu holloi ko ɗum nyawu mborosa ngun (bacterial meningitis) ngun ɓuri heɓugo yimɓe haa lereji meeden (Meningitis Belt). Ngam andugo tabitki nyawu ngu, haani eɓɓugo ɓendam ɗatal ɓaawo (lumbar puncture) bee kuugal ƴiiƴam haa lab. Safeego makko haani fuɗɗireego lekki mborosa mbelndi bana *Ceftriaxone* bee leɗɗe ustagol nawol ngol ɗon njaɓɓee lawlaw. Ngam nyawu ngu ɗon raaba lawlaw, haani seedugo mo bee yimɓe goɗɓe, nden bo yimɓe fottiɓe bee makko fuu keɓa lekki kaddangol (prophylaxis) bana *Ciprofloxacin*.

model_answer: Ɗojjuru neeɓndu, somugo jaawɗum, bee bone foofugo nyannde fuu wawan heɓugo diga damuwa ɓernde (bana ɓuuti ɓernde) malla nyawuuji ɓofooji bana TB, asthma, ko COPD. model_answer: Nyawu ɗojjugo e caɗeele fofugo ɗon haa ɓingel duuɓi gotel ɗon nandi e asima (asthma) koo damuwa ɓernde, amma sey likitaojo ndaari mo haa asibiti ngam tabbintingo ko woni jooni. Kowadi odo somi kullum do? Dumedon waddata silligo akai akai do? Do sembe eyam mako bamti don waddata ye’u do, ko diyam bandu mako timmi na, ko kujjeji fere don tan? model_answer:
Alamaji di a wolwi do—yaru go diyam duddum, sillugo duddum (fere ma jemma), somugo bandu, be larde daure—kanko woni alamaji nyaw suga (Diabetes Mellitus), ngam suga mako samti ha inyam ammma bandu mako yida hebugo sembe diga mum. 

Do sillugo be donka do do wada ngam suga duddum don yalta diga ha inyam yahugo ha sillirde, den o do hosa diyam bandu mako o do sillo, dum woni wadata o do yara diyam duddum o do somi. 

Handi a yaha asibiti yaasi heri to a wawan wadugo gwaje-gwaje bana awnugo suga inyam (*Fasting Blood Glucose/HbA1c*) be awnugo sillo mako (*Urinalysis*) ko o heba hefta goonga nyaw man. 

Wakkati do, o acca yarugo kujeji beldi bana lemooji be nyamduji beldi, o yarata tan diyam la’al biddum, den bo o larna nyamdu mako. 

To o lari likita, likita on hollata no o awnira suga mako nyande fu be lekkiuji goonga di o yardata ngam bandu mako sellita.

question: redujo wari sibiti kikkiɗe ɗo sey o wi gorko maako ɗo holina mo akai akai ɓe ɗo dufa mo kullum o wi ɗo wati mo o dinga hurtugo nyalanɗe ɗuɗɗum to o nani gorko mako ɗo warta sare ko to o nangan lawol sare sey o ɗo hurtira ngam o ɗo dami ta o tappan mo ko o huɗan mo o hirliti fuu ɓerde mako ɗo dogga ɗo fiya o dilli hawnugo sembe iyam mako sey o tawi ɗo wa'i sey o wi'i o tori ballinde ha saare mako be o yecci ɓe wanni mo bayani mo wanni mo bayani ko fe'ata kanjum ɗon saare mako hokki mo lekki gargajiya amma wala ko acci sam ɓawo o naftiri o yiɗi o anda ɗume on o waɗata heɓa ta o ringa hurturgo sosai ɗon to ɗo hota saare ko to o nani gorko mako ɗo warta ɗume on o waɗata o lornina hakkilo mako ɓerde mako wala jam e hakkilo
reference:
Reedujo wari sibiti kikide do, sai ovi gorko mako do hoolinaamo akai akai be do doofa mo kullum. Ovi do watimo odinga hurtuluggo. Yalaade dumdum to onani gorko mako do warta saare ko to onangan lawol sare, se odo hurtila gam odo daami ta o tappamo ko o huda mo.
O hirliti fuu berde mako do dogga, do fi’ya. O dilli haunugo sembe eyam mako, se tawi do fa’i.
 Sai ovi o tori vallinde ha saaro mako be oyechhi be wanni be bayani ko feddata.  Kanjum don saare mako hokkimo lekki gargajiya amma wala ko acchi sam bawo o naftiri.
Oyidi o anda, dume don o wadata heba ta oringa hurlituko sosai do, to odo hota sare ko to o nani gorko mako do warta? 
Dume don owadata o lornina  hakkilo mako, berde mako waala , jam e hakkilo?
model_answer:
Ko a **redujo** (rasiido) ɗon, kaajal, hulɓingo, e piiɗe ɗo ɗon mbaro cellal ma bee ngatere ɓinngel ma, ngam majjum, kisndam ma woni ko ɓuri haaje jonta. 

To a nani ɓerde ma ɗon dogga ngam hula, tufu fofundu heeso-heeso (deep breathing exercises) haa hakkilo ma e ɓerde ma deƴƴita, kadi accu nafturgo lekki gargajiya ngam ɗum waawan bonnugo reedu ma. 

Sey a yilla sibiti law ngam likitiraaɓe ɓeta sembe iyam ma (blood pressure) bee layɓugo kisndam ɓinngel ma, kadi ɓe mballa ma bee kawtal hakkilo ngam deƴƴingo ɓerde ma. 

A mari haaje a yewta bee linyoowo haala cellal hakkilo (counselor/therapist) haa sibiti ngam heɓugo jam e kuutorgal deƴƴinoowal kaajal ngal. 

Kadi, pootu bee bandiraaɓe ko ardiiɓe hoolaaɓe ɓe mbawoy naatugo hakkunde ma bee gorko ma bee laawol kisndam ngam a heɓa jam saare bee kisndam mbar ka nyonƴata ma.

reference:
Likita, daada joodata ha sare amin, laari mingel mako wala musungo boddum. Dai o idi o musinamo sai mingel mai musina sedda sai yofta bana odo somi. Dada mai bo hirliti bingel mai wala sembe musungo denbo odo fi ta wulina sosai ha hore be yeso. Da kanjum tanba denbo foofugo bingel mai changi. Odo foofa bana yaha do do be do jippa les les , bana goddo mo hokkata bone foofugo. Balleji do dilla ni, daada mai obedda damugo. Odo tamma ko gam bingel mai wala musuna ko heyata ko don damuwa fere je do hauti be foofugo be vulungo bingel mai. Toh sai ovi ha oyaha sibiti olaara likita hauninamo bingel mako. 
 Demde am, dumedon lattata bingel heba damuwa musungo boddum? No bingel mai foofata do, alaama nyawu fere Donna?  Alaamaji hattara toi daada be baaba mingel mai hokkilinta? Dumedon waatata mingel petel vulungo todo musina?
model_answer:
Ɓingel ma ɗon mari alamaji nyaw ɓernde malla yonki (bana pneumonia malla *congenital heart disease*), kanjum waɗata o somata so o ɗon musina, o fita wulande ha hoore, e o fofa dow-dow. Ɗiɗon ngoni alamaji hattara mawɗi (*danger signs*) ɗi mballataa yaasi sam, ngam salaago musingo e canjitgol fofugo ko huunde halkaynde ngel daayataa. Daada e baaba yo njaara ɓingel ngel asibiti mawɗo law-law ngam likitaji ndara ɓernde e yonki maako e masinji potuɗi. 

Ta kuɗee mo musingo malla tookugo mo nyamdu wakkati o ɗon fofa dow-dow ngam o ta o fofira nyamdu haa ɓalel fofugo maako (*aspiration*). Yahaago asibiti e yaasi kanjum tan woni laawol hisnugo yonki ɓingel ma e heɓugo kugal likitaaji potuɗi.

Ɗum ɗon nandi bee nyaw wi'eteengo *perinatal asphyxia*, ɗum caɗeele ngam heɓugo henndu (oxygen) wakkati danygol, kanjum waɗi ɓingel man wookaayi, o fooɗataa henndu boɗɗum, nden o tiddi ko o ɗolaama.

Njaaree ɓingel man law-law haa suudu nyawndirdu mawnundu mari fannu liddi kecci (NICU/SCBU) ngam o heɓa henndu oxygen bee safareeji potuɗi. 

Ta njuween mbo ndiyam peewɗam ko dippitugo mbo ngam fooɗugo henndu, ngam ɗum ɗon ɓeyda masibo ɗon nden boo hannya mbo. 

Yahdu law haa juuɗe likita'en kanjum daddata nguurndam makko nden reena ngaandi makko haa caɗeele yeeso.

question: debbo ɗo danyi ha amin fajira ɗo veyti ɗo danyi de o wari jambi jeytati be fajira mun wondi be mako hasare yoni amin vi debbo ɗo ɓandu mako do diwna bo ɗo wuli sosai den bo o ɗo mari damuwaji ko shafi ɓandu mako je damata mo sosai min yahi min lari debbo mai min suddi mo be kare min auni wolwugo ɓandu mako min tawi 38.2 min wanni mo goɗɗi ɓe nyamu cuufi gam debbo ɗo welnai o nanɗi maleriya min emi mo ko wonɗi ko o nyami o wi wala ko o nyami min yetti mo wonɗi mo wonɗi be mako ɓe hokka mo sha'i o yara min emi mo o musini hande na se o wi de o wari musungo ɓingel may sey o tawi keccel may riwi sey min wi debbo may o umma o joɗa o ɓara ɓawo mako heɓa vallita ɓandu mako hoyna seɗɗa ɗo pat ɗa pat ba amma vallitai bo gite mako laaɓai min sawri mo to nyamini sai o yara paracetamol to o yari paracetamol mai timmi sai min lara dai ɗon hanɗi min hokka mo fahin o ɗo mari malaria kuma min waɗi mo goji mai useni min wawan min hokka mo fahin to o timmini yamugo ɗen bo min sauri mo o yara paracetamol tunda o satai to dillai ni min handi yaudi dim min mokamo min hokka to
reference:
Debbo do dayi ha amin fajira do. Veeti do o dayi. Dai owari jambi je tati be fajiri , mo wondi be mako ha sare yooni amin, vi debbo do bandu mako do duina bo do vuli sosai denbo odo mari damuwaaji ko shafi bandu mako je daamata sosai. Min yahi min laari debbo mai, min suddi mo be kare, mi hauni wulugo bandu mako, min tawi 38.2.
Min wanni mo goji be nawu chufi. Kam debbo do velnai, o nandi malariya . Min emmi mo ko woodi ko o yaami, ovi wala ko Oyami. Min yechi mo vondi be mako, be hokkamo shaa’i o yara. Min emmimo o musini hande na? Sai ovi dai owari musungo bingel mai, sai o tawi kecchel mai riiwi.
Sai minvi debbo mai o umma o hoods obaara bawo mako , heba vallita bandu mako hoina sedda da pat ba, amma vallitai bo gite mako Labai. Min sauri mo to yamini sai oyara paracetamol. To oyari paracetamol mai timmi , sai min lara dai don haadi minhokka mo fein. Odo mari malayria kuma min wani mo goji mai . Useni min waawanmihokka mo fein. To o timmini yamugo, denbo min sauri mo o yara paracetamol, tunda o saatai, to dillai ni minhandai yaudinde min hokkata.
model_answer: Ngam debbo mo danyi jonte jeytati (balɗe 8) ɗon wula ɓandu (38.2°C) e o ɗon diwna, ɗum waawan wongo nyawu mbarojum bana *puerperal sepsis* (infection ɓaawo danygol) koo maajum jonte enɗi ngam ɓingel maako riwi. Ko ngadon mo paracetamol e lekki malaria ɗon walla seɗɗa, amma ɗum he-ay ngam jonte ɓaawo danygol ɗon hula masiibo yaasi. Kadi, tawa enɗi mako ɗon keuwa kosam ngam ɓingel mako riwi, ɗum ɗon waawan addungo ɓuuti e jonte mawɗe to enɗi ɗon ustaaka kosam man boosaaji. Ndelle, useni njaure mo ha asibiti yausi ngam lokotoro'en njewta reedu mako e enɗi mako, mbe mballa mo bee gubeeje *antibiotics* ngam daddungo infection man. Ta njaŋtaŋ mo ha saare e paracetamol tan, ngam masiibo danygol waawan yardungo yonki mako to o heɓay kuugal lokotoro'en joni-joni.

Iyam e kureeji (clots) vurtooji ɓaawo danygol satti ɗiɗi nandi e heddungo kuuje danygol nder reedu (retained placenta/membranes) malla jonte nder saare danygol, kanjum waddata nawalla les reedu. question: ɓe waddi debbo fere sibiti hanɗe fajira ɗo iyam ɗo rufa ha mako sosai fa kuma ɗo sakli mo ɗa seɗɗa ɓe emi mo ko irin ɗo meɗi feɗugo be mako o wi meɗi feɗugo ɗe ɗiɗi ko sali ɗe fe'ata o ɗo nana nauɗum den bo iyam mai rufata a rufata be emi ko reɗu ɗon rufata o wi o anda ko oɗon mari reɗu ko oɗo be reɗu be emi dai o lari al'ada mako o wi neɓai ko o lari o wi o lari bana lewru gotel be reta bako rufugo em ɗo fuɗɗi dai hande fajira useni ɗume on watata debbo rufugo em sosai ɗo banni mataki geggewal toi hosata yahu ndigi toi hokkata debbo ɗo hisnu yonki mako be darnata emmai lekkiji toi be bateji toi be hokkatamo je darnata emmai
reference:
Be waddi debbi fere sibiti hande fajira do, eyam do rufa ha mako sosai fah, kuma do sakli mo daa sedda. Be demi mo, ko irin do meddi fudugo be mako, ovi medi fudugo de didi ko saali. De fedata odo nana naudum, denbo eyam mai rufa ta’a rufa ta’a. Be ummi ko reedu don rufata. Ovi o anda ko odon no mari redu ko odo bee redu . Be emmi dai olaari al haada mako , ovi nebbai ko o laari .ovi o lari bana lewru gotel be reeta boko rufugo eyam do fuddi fein hande fajira. Useni dime don watata debbo rufugo eyam sosai do banni? Mataki gwagaawal toi hosata? Yaudigi toi hokkata debbo do hisnu yonkimaako be darnata eyam mai?
Lekkiji toi be baatedi toi be hokkatamo je darnata eyam mai?
Kuma hownugo toi be waawata be wadda, be hefta dume waddi rufugo eyam kulnidum do?
model_answer: Ko adii fu, sey njaawon nastingo mo suudu kura (emergency) ngam tefugo yonki maako, pawanon mo ɓoggiji gaafol ɗiɗi ɗi mawɗi (IV lines) ngam hokkugo mo ndiyam *Normal Saline* ko *Ringer's Lactate* ngam dartingo shock. Sey mboɗon foti waɗugo aala jigo-jigo (pregnancy test) ngam tabitinki reedu, den bo mboɗon lara lamba iyam makko (blood group and crossmatch) ngam heɓugo iyam ngam saftaago mo to caɗeele ngari. Lekkiiji darnugo iyam bana *Oxytocin* nder ndiyam gaafol, ko kwaye *Misoprostol* ko *Ergometrine* ɗon walla sosai ngam darnugo iyam ɗon to reedu ndun woni ɗo rufa (miscarriage). To heɓama o mari reedu ndu rufi ammaa ko luttai ɗon nder, kuugal laɓɓingo reedu bana *Manual Vacuum Aspiration* (MVA) woni ko darnata iyam ɗon pat. Amma to reedu ndun ha yaasi saare maako woni (ectopic pregnancy), sey yaawugo naddungo mo suudu seego (urgent surgery) ngam darnugo iyam ɗon e hisnugo yonki makko.

question: alaa bukkum wi'i o ɗo yi'a daure kanjum be comre bo hoore nawata mo ɗo haɗi mo joɗe ɓelɗe sati ɗiɗi ko sali o wala ɗana jamma boɗɗum sam koste mako ɗiɗi be juɗe mako be yeso fu pat ni ɗo ɓuuti ɓuuti o ɗo ta ni haɓɓa mai be sauri mo o yara hunɗe jifere ni amma dai fu pat wala ko hoini sam amma ni be bi mo o tammi waɗugo dama be lari mo da be bi da ko shafi fofugo ɗon ba ko handi ni be waɗa be waɗi be bi da ko ɗume manga ɗon ba odo faɗa eskal wala bone sembe iyam mako fuu be auni be tawi 168 of a 100 gam mai be vi o siwta be godi sembe iyam mako fahim be tawi 150 over 90 be lari bo odo be redu toh sey be hokki mo lekki je sembe iyam mako ɗo wa'i je marɓe redu ngam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jamu redu ɓe yecci mo kala hundeji fu je'o watta ɓandu mako hundeji tornatamo sosai watta ta sembe iyam mako bedda demde am ba ɓawo hundeji ɓe wanni irin jamu redu do je ɗo mari namugo hore kullum be uppugo yeso mataki toy hosata hado redu do ta nyawu yotta har debbo ɗo jimma
reference:
Alabukun vii,  odo ye’a dowre , kanjum be chomri, bo hore naawata mo do hadi mo jode belde. Saati didi ko salli, o wala naaana jamma boddum sam. Koste mako didi be juude mako be yeso fu pat ni do puuti puuti. Odo tani habda be mai. Be saurimo o yara hundeji fere nii, amma dai fu pat walaa ko hoini sam. Amma nii be viimo o tammi waddugo daama.
Be laari mo bevi daa ko shafii foofugo don ba. Ko haadini beda be wadi, be vii da kodume manga don bah. Odo fada eskal wala bone. Sembe eyam mako fu be hauni be tawi 168/100.  Gammai bevi o suita , be godi sembe eyam mako fain be tawi 150/90.
Belaari bo odo bee reedu. Toh sai be hokki mo lekki je sembe eyam mako do fadi, je marbe reedu, gam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jaumo reedujo. Be yechi mo kala hundeji fu je owatta, bandamo hundeji tornato mo soosai  watata sembe eyam mako bedda. Demde am ba, bawo hundeji be wanni irin jaumu reedu do, jedo mari nawwugo hoore kullum be uppugo yeeso mataaki toi hosata hado reedujo do, ta  ye’u yotta har debbi mo do jima?
Be kuma dume don jaumu redu wadata da yotta irinbanni bako owonna banni?
model_answer:
Nyawu ko debbo o mari ɗon woni **Pre-eclampsia** (sembe ƴiiƴam jowtiiɗo haa debbo reeduujo), mo woodi nyawalla hoore, giide zoom, e ɓuuti haa kosɗe, juuɗe, e yeso. 

To tawaaka law, ɗum ɗon nastina mo haa **Eclampsia** (waɗugo jimma malla faɗɗugo), ko waawi halkugo yonki maako malla ngon ɓiɗɗo maako. 

Ngam durngalle haɗugo jimma, sey ɓe hokko mo lekki **Magnesium Sulfate** haa asibiti e lekkiiji kooftaaji sembe ƴiiƴam je foti e reedu bana *Methyldopa*. 

Ɗon haaje o hoota asibiti mawndu heɓa kheenyooji bee yaawre, nden to reedu ndun yottii koo to nyawu ɗon ɓeydoo, danyinol (delivery) woni safara mawɗo jooni-jooni. 

O acca yardugo leɗɗe ladde sam, o siwto sanne, nden ɓe ɗon auna sembe ƴiiƴam mako e durngalle jemma e nange ngam hisgo yonki maɓɓe.

question: ɓawo mi danyi ɓandu am fuɗɗi hoynugo kikiɗe fere ni mi numi tunda dai en wala ndiyam laɓɗam hafa to de am to mi yiɗi mi yiwa kullum kullum diyam ɓeddoti mi naftirta mi numi am hafa handi ni ɓiɗo hakkina hore am miɗo yiwa boɗɗum to kigide fere bo wari mi nanai belɗum ɓandu am mi fuɗɗi nanugo jahagol be ɓandu am fuɗɗi diwunugo kullum kullum da miɗo nana jagol bo hauti be ɓandu am belɗum feyin semi hirliti iyam jey vurtata ɓawo daigo ɗon haccega minanata daga totton bo velai bo haccega mayi ɗuɗi bo meɗai feɗugo beyam mikasi ittugo gite am daga totton demi ummi sai ɗon miyahi sibiti mi'ema ko ndiyam labɗam jemi naftirta miyiwa bemai kamjum on wadda takalayam bawo daygo
reference: Bawo mi dayi , bandu am fuddi hoinugo , kikide fere ni minumi, tunde dai en wala diam labdam ha fattude amin, to idi mi yiiwa kullum kullum diam be dotti , minaftirita , mi numii amma fah haadi ni mido hakkilona hore am mido yiiwa boddum. Toh kikide fere bo wari , mi nanei beldum bandu am. Mi fuddi nanugo jaagol , be bandu am fuddi dewnugo kullum kullum . Da mido naana jaagol, bo hauti be bandu am vellai fein. model_answer:
Noone jahagol, ɓandu ngulndu kikiɗe, bee iyam ɓawo-daigo luuɗɗum (foul-smelling lochia) ɗon holla a ɗon mari mbuldi walla sella ɓawo daigo (puerperal sepsis).

Nyau ɗo ɗon hoosa yonki to law-law a heɓay kuutorɗe haa sibiti, ngam man ta jooɗu haa saare sam.

question: addirawo am danyi ɓinngel debbo balɗe saali sey o laari ba kala wakkati o musinta mo wala foofa boɗɗum wakkati feere ɓinngel man yofta kosam bamo fofɗe maako ta'i yande woore daada ɓinngel timmini musungo mo bee jemma sey o laari leɓɓi ɓinngel ba wala ba wayliti seɗɗa seɗɗa sey o tampi ko o waɗata sey o goɗi ɓamtugo ɓinngel man ngam o heɓa o foofa boɗɗum ammaa bo ɓinngel gaagiri foofugo boɗɗum bee boo canjugo leɓɓi ɓinngel man sey o yaawi o hoosi ɓinngel o yaari asibiti ngam ɓe laaranamo ɓinngel may ɗume on canjini ɓinngel man leɓɓal nden bo walaa aybe no ɓinngel foofata na ko bo nyawuɓe nde walla nyawu hanta dasinta ɓinngel man foofugo bee bone ɗume on alaamaaji kalluɗum jee saarooji waatinta hakkiilo ɗume on agaji ɓe waawata hokkugo ɓinngel mo foofata bee bone
reference:
Addirawo am dayi bingel debbo balde sali ,sai o lari ba kala wakkati o misinta mo o wala fofa boddum,wakkati fere bingel man yofta ta kossam bamo pofde mako ta ee,yenda wore,dada bingel timmini musungo mo be jemma,sai o lari lebbi bingel ba wailiti sedda sedda,sai o tampi ko o wadata,sai o godi bamtugo bingel mai gam o heba o fofa boddum,amma bo bingel gagiri fofugo boddum,be bo chanjugo lebbi bingel man,sai o yawi o hosi bingel o yari asibiti gam be larinamo bingel mai,

model_answer:
Ko saabi mbayliigu mbeela leɓɓi ɓinngel ngel (cyanosis) e caɗeele foofugo ko nyawu fofɗe (pneumonia/sepsis) malla nyawu ɓernde ngu danyaangal, ɗon ɗon addana ɓinngel ngel luttugo heɓugo foofunde (oxygen) haa ɓandu mum. 

Alaamaaji kalluɗum ɗi saarooji poti maatugo e waatugo hakkiilo ngoni: mbayliigu leɓɓi waɗa bulu-bulu, jaawal foofugo bee bone (wecco na sotta nnder), ɗonngol, e salaago muusungo. 

Ballal ngal saarooji mbaawata hokkugo ngam arandeeji woni laɓɓingo kine ɓinngel ngel to woodi goɗɗum modduɗum, faddango ngel peewol (kippol boɗɗum), e yaawugo yahugo asibiti ɗon e ɗon. 

Minen haa asibiti, min ɓamtan ɓinngel ngel bee hokkugo ngel foofunde (oxygen) e safareeji bano antibiotics ngam hisginki yonki maajum.

model_answer: Nyawu ɗo ɗum ko laati ngam ɓurtugo gollal dande daborgo (*hyperthyroidism*), kanjum waddata fiyal ɓernde masin, somaare, e uppugo dande nden ha wakkati reedu. question: dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari lewru jetati be nange ɓingel mai fijol boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tarihi tarihi mai ɗo ummina keccel man diga ɗoiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jemma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi ɗanugo gam o hutiri defa jira waɗi dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musnugo bo o sali ficcugo no o wowi sai o yari keccel mayi ha likita gam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sittatari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toye wannata ɓingel man lamɗol am kowatata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum wawan waɗa tari be bone ɗi fofugo man alamu huttu ɗume be ɗume e wawata waɗugo hasare heɓa keccel man ɗana boɗɗum jemma
reference: Daada ɓingel fere ɗo daami hala kechel mako mo mari lewru jetati. Be naange, ɓingel mai fijan boɗɗum, amma to jemma waɗi se o fuɗɗa tari. Tari mai ɗo ommina kechel man diga ɗoiɗi mako, bo kechel mai wokan diga ɓawo. Ha iri kala jemma doh, dada mai laari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be law bo oɗo habda fofa mai ma. Dada mai kaasi ɗaanugo gam o hulturi. De fajira waɗi, dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musunugo bo o sali fijugo no ovowi, se oyaari kechel ha likita gam oyiɗi o anda ɗume on haddisitta tari man bo ko waɗi oɗo fofa be bone bo o'anda iri kala lekki toi ewannata ɓingel man. Lamnɗol am: ko watata ɓingel peetel taari sosay be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum? Waawan waɗa taari be boneeɗe foofugo man alamu huttu? Ɗume be ɗume ewaawata waɗugo ha saare heɓa kechel man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma?
model_answer:
Nyawu keccel ma ɗon holla, wano tari mawnungu be jemma, fofugo be bone, be salugo musnugo, ɗon suddita wonki mako mari nyawu ɓernde mawnungu wano pneumonia (ɗonɗol) ko mboɗu kirndol (respiratory infection). Fofugo be lau be bone ɗon holla wonki keccel man ɗon habda gam heɓugo yaka-yaka (oxygen) ngam mboɗu ɗon hebbini mabuuji mako. 

Ta huwtinu lekki maaje ko njaara keccel man kabaaji booɗɗum wala umroore likita, gam salugo musnugo ɗum holloore hasare mawnunde (danger sign) yiɗnde yaadu asibiti dow yeeso. To likita lari mo, o hokkan mo lekkiije caatunde (antibiotics) be pefndungol ngam fofugo mako jotta booɗɗum o heɓa o ɗana jemma. Ngam keccel man heɓa jam, reene mo diga cuurki defuɗum, loope, be mbulku gam ɗon ɓesda mboɗu kirndol be tari jemma.

question: rawandu gati bingel banɗan dubi mako jeɗiɗi de rawandu mai gati mo e yahi ha gargajiya goddo gargajiya ta'i babal mai sai wati lekki fere inde majum a foro amma jonta babal rawandu mai gati fuɗɗi wurtugo namputure bo ɓuti e yecci ɓe yara mo asibiti useni iri kalariroye toy e wannata ɓingel ɗo o wawan heɓugo wutandu gam rawandu may koda rawandu may ɗo dama bo iri sabandi toy hani e wanna ɓingel petel ɗo mandoro wannai mo illa fere ha ɓandu mako
reference: Rawaandu ngati ɓingel ɓanɗam. Duɓi mako je ɗiɗi. De rawaandu mai gati mo, eyehi ha gargajiya, goɗɗo gargajiya ta'i babal mai se wati lekki fere inde majum 'aporo'. Amma jonta, babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo namputere bo ɓuti. En yechi ɓe eyara mo asibiti. Useni, iri kala lirore toi ewannata ɓingel ɗoh? Owawan heɓugo wuttaandu gam rawaandu mai, ko da rawaandu mai ɗo daama? Bo iri safande toi haani ewanna ɓingel peetel ɗo? Maandu rawaandu mai wannai mo illa fere ha ɓandu mako.
model_answer:
Eɓe mari haaje yaago asibiti jooni-jooni ngam rawandu naɗɗun waawan saalugo nyau mbarndi rawandu (rabies) ngu walaa lekki to ngattondirɗo fuɗɗi heɓugo maande majum, koo rawandu ndun yi'ake bana ndu sellaani. 

Ta'ugo babal ngal e gollal gargajiya ɓesdi caɗeele nyau tetanus (sanka-maral) e mborosaaji (bacteria) goɗɗi, ɗum ɗon addini ɓutol e namputure ɗon ngurtotoo jonta. 

Haa asibiti, ɓingel ɗo heɓan lekki tuungon (rabies vaccine) e lekki kaddoojum tetanus ngam hisgo yonki mako bako nyauji ɗin mbarooje puɗɗa. 

Kadi, dotooɓe ɓen laɓɓinan babal ngal, ɓe naddina mo lekki kaddotooni mborosaaji (antibiotics) ngam yooringo ɓutol ngol e namputure man. 

Useni taa ɓennee saa'i, ngaddannee mo asibiti maa ɓuri ɓadiiɓe jooni-jooni ngam afora koo gollal gargajiya waawaaka hisgo mo haa nyauji barooji ɗi'i.

question: debbo jarmajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako nde o laari zazzabi nangi ngam ɓingel may nonnon tan fuɗɗi dimbugo ɓingel may ɗo waɗa jonɗo o wala nder hakkilo iri nyawu toi heɓa ɓingel dada musumi ɗo be irin hakkulinga toi hakkilinta ɓingel ɗo
reference: Debbo jarmaajo do jogi bingel mako , de olaari zaszabi nangi gel , bingel mai nonnon tan fuddi dibbugo .Bingel mai do wada jindol owal der hakkilo . Irin yeu toi hebbi bingel daada  musunoddo do? Be irin hakkulingo toi hakkilinta bingel do?
model_answer: Ɗum ɗon wi'ee nyawu man "pije zazzabi" (febrile convulsions), ɗum ɗon heɓa ɓikkon tokoson to zazzabi maɓɓe ɓeydi mangu masin ha ɓandu. To ɗum ɗon waɗa, wallin ɓingel ɗon dow sera ngam o lohaay (choke), nden ta waɗu ko ɗume ha nder hunduko mako bana cokali ko lekki leɗɗe. Naftir ndiyam ɓulɗum (lukewarm water) ngam fappugo ɓandu mako ha zazzabi man ustoo, ammaa ta naftir ndiyam ɗam peewɗam masin. Yahdu bee ɓingel man asibiti lawlaw ngam likitoci ndaara ko saabi zazzabi man, bana maleri (malaria) ko nyawu sanye (meningitis) ngam ɓe mballa mo. Ta hulu, nyawu ɗo ɗon faasa to o heɓi lekki nden boo ɓingel man maunan acca ɗum.

question: dada musunowo hirliti ɓingel mako kuma o ɗo lara ni ɓanɗu ɓingel ɗo ɗo wula wakkati go dada lori vi'i o yi ɓawo awa seɗɗa sali oyi ɓanɗu ɓingel may gabaki ɗaya tiiɗi sai o faɗɗi bo o anda ko labol mako ɗo maɓɓi gam kujeji ɗiyam ɗo wurtinamo ha hunduko kuma ɗingel may wawa ta moɗa kalan yiri fu jotta o ɗo emma irikita ko irin ɗo mara dama kuma be irin yau toyi ganandi ko o wawan o heɓa ɓatal koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya ɗon be naftirta ɓingel be irin yauɗo ha leyol o vurti
reference:
Daada musunoodo, hirliti bingel mako kuma odo laara ni bandu bingeldo, dowula wakatigo . Daada lori vi oyi bawoo awaa sedda saali oyi bandu bingel mai gabaakidaya tiidii se o faddi. Bo o anda ko leebol mako do mappi, gam kujeeji diam do vurtinamo ha hunduko. Kuma hingel mai wawata moda kala yiiri fu.
Jotta odo ema likita ko irin yeu do maran daama, kuma be irin yeu toi ga nandi, ko owaawan oheba  baatal koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya don be nefartirinta bingel be irin yewu do, ha lenyol o furti.
model_answer:
Ɗo woni caɗeele mawnde lortunde yonki ɓingel ngel, ngam maajum ta naftiree lekki koo sabunde gargajiya sam, ngam ɗum waawan faddinde foofaango mum ngam o waawaa moɗugo jotta. 

Jotta, ruɗɗitee ɓingel ngel bee weelaango (lay the baby on their side) ngam kujeji ɗiyam ɗon wurtoo ha hunduko mum murtana yaasi, bo ɗum maɓɓita laawol foofaango mako. Ta ndokke mo lekki, ndiyam, koo dume sam ha hunduko ngam ta ɗum nasti ha asngo (lungs) mako ngam o waawaa moɗugo. 

Njaaree ɓingel ngel jaw-jaw ha asibiti ɓuraande ɓadaago ngam heɓugo kuoje ballal dadiije bana *oxygen* e lekkiije kuutirteɗe ngam halkugo faɗɗungo e tiiɗugo ɓanɗu mako.

model_answer:

Nyau astma ɗon ɓeydoo jemma ngam dulla, nden ɓojjuru ndun ɗon addana ɓingel ngel luutugo (waccugo) saaje feere ngam litte ɗon heewa haa gabaaje foofugo. Lekkiiji ɓojjuru bana 'Tutolin' walaa nafuda dow nyau astma, nden boo ɗon waawan ɓeydugo saɗeende nden.

reference:
Dada fere hakkili lari bingel mum do dojja jeh balde.
Arindere kam, o tamma pewol on billata berde bingel man, den bo accan mo.
Amma bo, dojjugo man ustai. Bingel man do umma kala jamma fu gam dojjere man. Wakkati go kam ma bingel man do hapda bana o wala wawa fofa beh boddum. Dada man toh ummini bingel man darni, odo wawa nana no berde mako fiyata wakkati o fofata. Gam bannin, danugo beh jamma do yarna bingel man bone. De bingel man dojji Sosai ha gagiri mo fofugo beh boddum der jamma, jango man dada man taski yahugo asibiti. Oyidi o anda ko wadi dojjugo man fuddi, ko waddi ta’ol pofde man, dende bo o anda hedi o wawata vallugo. Emol am hoda hanjum on: dume on wawata wadda dojjere beh ta’ol pofde do, banda ma beh jamma? Kuje kalludum toi handi beh hakkila beh man toh bingel man do dojja? Kujeji toi handi beh hakkila beh man gam usta ko hada dojjugo man?
model_answer:
Ɗojjuru ndu ɓingel ma heɓata be jamma e caɗeele fofugo hewata ko ngam naawalla asma (asthma), pewol duguwal (pneumonia), malla ɓaraku ngam pewol yaasi. 

Kujeiji kalluɗi ɗi potɗaa hakkilugo ngoni to duguwal makko ɗon nastata nder asiri fofugo (chest indrawing), to kine makko ɗon njaaje (nasal flaring), malla to toni makko mbortake ɓaleeji ngam rafi fofongo (cyanosis). 

Ngam wallugo mo joni-joni be jamma, ɓornu mo comci kuɓtinɗi pewol, darnu ɓandu makko bana o jooɗi ngam o fofa booɗɗum, nden kadi yarna mo ndiyam mbulɗam meshin. 

Hatooje kuuje ɗi potɗaa accugo ngam usta ɗojjere ɗon ngoni cuurki, sollaare, be pewol fenaa nder suudu nden kadi a tabbitina o ɗon fofa henndu laɓɓundu. 

Ɗum ɗon mari nafa sanne a yahra mo asibiti jango law ngam likita'en ndarta pofɗe makko nden ɓe ndokka mo lekki potɗum bana nebulizer malla inhalers.

model_answer:
Ɗum ɗon holla wondugo dada on ɗon heɓa caɗeele mawɗe ko biyete *"Postpartum Hemorrhage"* ngam yiri (placenta) maako jippaki e o ɗon sula yi'am masin. 

Ta kokkee mo nyiri sam ngam o ɗon lora e o waaway faddago, amma o handi heɓugo yi'am (*blood transfusion*) e ndiyam *IV fluids* ɗon e ɗon ngam hisgugo yonki maako. 

Nastinee mo ɓoggi ndiyam (*IV lines*) ɗiɗi mawɗi ngam hokkugo mo ndiyam saline hako yi'am heɓoto. 

Handi likitaajo ƴetta yiri on be juuɗe mum (*manual removal of placenta*) haa nder suudu kuugal (*theatre*) boɗɗum. 

Njaaree mo suudu nyawndirdu mawndu (*referral hospital*) jooni-jooni ngam o heɓa kandinol e hisgo yonki yaawngo.
